# World Cup Prop Firm Deals

This dataset tracks every World Cup deal published on PropFirmDiscount.com by a
prop firm carrying a verified discount code.

Deals tracked: 19 across 11 firms. Newest deal: 2026-07-18.
Every deal row carries that firm's discount code, which works any time.

Event page: https://propfirmdiscount.com/tag/world-cup/
Event dataset: https://propfirmdiscount.com/api/prop-firm-events/
Deal rows for this event: https://github.com/propfirmdiscounts/world-cup-prop-firm-deals
All firms: https://github.com/propfirmdiscounts/prop-firm-discount-codes
